coverage.description: Breakaway and disputed areas worldwide, from Kashmir to the Elemi Triangle (99 polygons in version 5.1.1)

collection.known_issues: Shows Natural Earth's de facto boundaries (who controls the territory), not de jure. Some small areas would be better drawn as points. Not a legal or authoritative boundary source.
collection.notes: Version 5.1.1. Shapefile (zip) in WGS84 geographic coordinates (EPSG:4326), 99 polygons, 168 attribute columns. Used as a filter-only input: Places whose country is a disputed area are exempt from country-code checks. Not published in any Overture theme.
